recommendations.reason: Revalidated in this recording, but no safe focused patch is established. Origins 893, 894, 895, 856 and 896 all border flammable grass; visibility refresh alone cannot admit unknown drinking. Known liquid flame does not establish contained spread, safe firing/retreat, collateral protection or verified expiry. Next derive the observed entrance/grass/chest fixture and validate one bounded known-flame preparation transaction with accepted throw receipts, contained spread, protected supplies, expiry and fresh bank/stash/round-trip admission. Add refusal regressions for unknown spread, threatened retreat, collateral loot, active effects and failed receipts. If containment cannot be established, require executable nonconsumptive identification instead. Keep mandatory pickup, hazard checks and terminal planner exhaustion intact.

review.review: The planner stopped with the hero alive at full health, not dead. Decision 187 (log line 526) reveals a flock-trap room and Chest 1136; preparation then declines, and decision 188 reports the reserved flight candidate. At decision 217 (line 613), mandatory potion discovery cannot proceed because levitation remains unidentified and the recognized room is unfinished. Offline reconstruction of the played source matches all 217 earlier actions, reasons, intents and controllers before reproducing this blocker. Copied-state probes find five hypothetical protected chest-trip origins, but every origin has grass or high grass in its unknown-drink safety neighborhood. The same obstruction exists at first chest sight; neither hunger nor an exhausted travel allowance explains it. The final accepted pickup (line 611) advances the clock and leaves HP at 25/25. Full source resolves the selecting-state gap, but does not establish a safe replacement. Known liquid flame is carried, yet no validated containment, retreat, inventory-protection and fire-expiry contract authorizes using it to prepare these banks. No policy patch or new regression is supplied because relaxing flammable-terrain checks or testing far away could destroy supplies or waste the required protection. The unchanged Python suite passes 1868 tests, with four skipped; no baseline-red/candidate-green claim is made.
review.learnings: Treat safe identification and protected retrieval as separate prerequisites that must both be executable. A valid hypothetical flight trip does not make its grassy origin safe for an unknown potion. Preserve mandatory pickup and supply reservations while establishing bounded terrain preparation or a genuine nonconsumptive identification alternative.
